name: the_sightline
conceit: A single vertical axis (crowd at street level, a tall tree trunk rising through frame, a small figure in the branches) is climbed and then closed by one returning line of sight -- the small figure looking down, the standing figure below looking directly up -- so the whole beat is carried by convergence along one axis, never a cut to a new angle.

anti: a scene with no real vertical axis, or where the two parties never actually need to visually find each other across a height difference

plate_bill.must_contain: full-height street scene: a dense crowd shown only as backs of heads along the bottom of frame, a tall tree trunk rising through the center, branches spreading near the top, no visible crowd faces
close view partway up the trunk and lower branches, one small robed figure perched on a branch, looking down and outward, dappled leaf shadow
view looking up from street level into the branches: the small figure above looking down, another figure far below at the base of the trunk looking directly up, one hand slightly raised

motion_slots.earned_by: the moment the two lines of sight actually meet (P3) is the one beat worth a paid clip -- a small confirming motion (a raised hand, a head tilt) at the exact convergence; the climb itself (P1-P2) stays on the $0 camera.

beat_template.hook: the crowd at street level, the tree trunk rising through them, the vertical axis established
beat_template.pivot: climbing the trunk to the small figure perched in the branch, looking down
beat_template.landing: the two lines of sight meet -- the figure above and the figure below, looking directly at each other

score_shape: a rising, climbing figure under the ascent from crowd to branch, holding suspended at the perch, resolving into one clear held tone the instant the two lines of sight meet.
